lesson.title: sort: whose fault is this status code?
lesson.body: A web server answers every request with a number. The first digit tells you who has to fix it.

result.say: **2xx** worked, **4xx** means fix the request, **5xx** means the server has to be fixed.

lesson.title: match: which customer does each order belong to?
lesson.body: A SQL `JOIN` pairs rows from two tables when a column has the same value in both.
lesson.say: An inner join keeps only the pairs. Order 4 and Linus have no partner, so they drop out of the result.

lesson.title: flow: what happens when Claude tries to edit a file

steps.text: Claude decides to edit `app.py` and announces the tool call.
Before anything is written, Claude Code hands the request to the hook.
The hook asks one question: does the lock file exist? A quiz is pending, so it does.
So the hook exits with code **2**. That means block, and tell Claude why.
Claude gets the message and waits for your pass code. `app.py` was never touched.

lesson.title: slider: how far does a slice reach?
lesson.body: `letters[:n]` takes items from the start, up to but **not including** position n.
lesson.label: n

positions.say: `a` and `b`. Position 2 (`c`) is where it stops, not included.
All five. There is no position 5, and that's fine.

lesson.title: build: assemble the line that totals weight by region
lesson.body: Start with the table, split it into piles, pick the column, then do the math.
lesson.say: Table, then split by region, then the weight column, then add each pile up.

lesson.title: compare: what sorting does to the table
lesson.say: Same rows, new order. Nothing was added, removed or changed.

questions.prompt: Fill the blank so this gives the average weight per region.
questions.why: `mean` is pandas' word for average. `sum` adds, `count` counts rows, and there is no `avg` in pandas (that one is SQL).

questions.prompt: This should print the total weight per region. Which line has the bug?
questions.why: The two column names are swapped. It should split by `region` and add up `weight`: `df.groupby('region')['weight'].sum()`.

questions.prompt: Match each status code to what it means.

The server broke while handling it

questions.why: 2xx worked, 4xx is a problem with the request, 5xx is a problem on the server.
